# Default ability weights: coins compared with Rainbow Granter

*Generated by `tools/write-ability-notes.js` from `ability-value.js` (the numbers the app uses). Do not edit by hand.*

The pet rankings weigh each ability family. By default Rainbow Granter is 100% and every other family is its **coins per day ÷ Rainbow Granter's coins per day**, each at its best tier and full strength (100 STR), in one late-game reference garden. You can change any weight in the app (Pets → Pet rankings → What counts).

## The reference garden (measured)

From the owner's garden layout (`ability-reference.json`, the anonymised `tests/fixtures/garden-layout.json`):

- 270 crops worth 612.21B in all.
- 35 uncoloured crops (no Gold or Rainbow), worth 176.2M each on average: what Gold and Rainbow Granters can upgrade.
- Coloured crops are worth 2.58B each on average, with an average colour multiplier of 36.8 (Gold ×25, Rainbow ×50).
- A finished crop's base value (its value ÷ colour ÷ its weather-and-moon multiplier) averages 4.5M.
- 10 crops aren't full size (worth 45.80B); 0 lack a weather mutation; 24 lack a moon mutation.

Mutation multipliers (crop-data.js): Gold ×25, Rainbow ×50; Wet ×2, Chilled ×2, Frozen ×6, Thunderstruck ×5, Thundercharged ×7; Dawnlit ×4, Dawnbound ×7, Amberlit ×6, Amberbound ×10. A crop's value = base × colour × (sum of its weather and moon multipliers − how many it has + 1), so adding a ×m mutation to a finished crop adds colour × base × (m − 1).

## Assumptions (not in the layout)

- **Crops sold a day: 100.00B.** About what the Money tab shows getting ready a day in this garden (~99.5B). New crops a day = that ÷ a finished crop's value = 38.8.
- **Share of a crop's life spent growing: 10%.** The rest is waiting for weather and moons; growth speed only helps the growing part.
- **Share of a granted weather / moon mutation weather would have given anyway: 50%.** A granter mostly gets there sooner.
- **Weather-only abilities work about 25% of the time** (during their weather; the app's existing convention).
- **Extra seeds in a full garden are worth 5% of their price** (mostly unused). Prices used: divine 5B, mythical 500M, legendary 50M, uncommon 100K (the seed tiers' shop prices, rounded).
- **Room a new crop has to grow: 15 size points** (it stops at full size).
- **A Dawnbinder turns ~10 lit crops bound a day.**
- **Captures** (the owner's answers): a capsule takes the crop's Dawn / Amber mutation. A Dawn capsule is 0.5% a Dawnbreaker Spore, worth up to **28.00B** once grown and mutated, and 2.5% an Ube Seed; the rest is junk. Seeds count at **0.5** of their grown value (they take time and room). **Dawn captures cost nothing**: a crop holds one moon mutation, Amberbound (x10) beats Dawnbound (x7), and Gold / Rainbow is the slow part, so Dawn is farmed off (Thunderpeels are kept just for it) until Amberbound will land in time. Losing an Amber mutation does cost: the crop waits **0.5 day** for one back. **50%** of new crops get a Dawn mutation (the rest Amber). Measured: this garden made **7 Dawn captures** in a day (lifetime counter 105 -> 112). Amber capsules give pet shards (no coins).

## Late game (when your stage is Late)

From the owner: late gardens take every crop Thunderstruck -> Thundercharged (x7) in the weather slot and Amberlit -> Amberbound (x10) in the moon slot ("amber is king"). A crop holds one of each, so a Frozen, Wet or Chilled proc takes the weather slot with less, and Dawnlit is only worth farming for Dawn captures (Dawnbreaker Spores). The rankings use these weights when your stage is Late (Auto or picked); early and mid use the table above. These families change:

| Early / mid | Late | Family | How (late) |
|---|---|---|---|
| 13% | 24% | AmberlitGranter | min(28.8 procs/day, 42.2 crops lacking it a day) x 1.50B (x10 on a finished crop: 36.8 colour x 4.5M base x 9) x 0.5 (weather would give the rest) (late game: it starts the amberbound path) |
| 14% | 22% | ThunderstruckGranter | min(72.0 procs/day, 38.8 crops lacking it a day) x 999.4M (x7 on a finished crop: 36.8 colour x 4.5M base x 6) x 0.5 (weather would give the rest) (late game: it starts the thundercharged path) |
| 4% | 12% | Thundercharger | late game: min(288.0 charges/day, ~31.0 new Thunderstruck crops/day (80% of new crops)) x 36.8 x 4.5M x 2 (x7 - x5) |
| 12% | 4% | DawnlitGranter | late game: Amber is the goal, so a Dawnlit crop is only worth its Dawn capture: 38.8 procs/day x a capsule's 84.2M (0.5% a Dawnbreaker Spore, 2.5% an Ube Seed, at half for the time) |
| 4% | 0% | RainGranter | late game: the weather slot is kept for Thunderstruck -> Thundercharged (x7); wet (x2) would take it with less, so it counts for nothing |
| 4% | 0% | SnowGranter | late game: the weather slot is kept for Thunderstruck -> Thundercharged (x7); chilled (x2) would take it with less, so it counts for nothing |
| 18% | 0% | FrostGranter | late game: the weather slot is kept for Thunderstruck -> Thundercharged (x7); frozen (x6) would take it with less, so it counts for nothing |

## What this means

- **Rainbow Granter leads by a mile in a late-game garden**: each proc multiplies a crop ×50. Gold Granter is about half (×25), and the two compete for the same uncoloured crops.
- **Sell-side abilities scale with how much you sell.** Crop Refund (20% of sales back) is the best of them; Sell Boost IV averages +8%.
- **Weather and moon granters are limited by crops that lack the mutation**, not by how often they fire: in this garden every crop already has a weather mutation, so they only help new crops.
- **Growth boosts are weak late-game**: growing is a small part of a crop's life, and faster growing doesn't make weather come sooner.
- **Coin and seed finders are rounding errors** next to mutation multipliers on billion-coin crops.
- **Dawn Capture is free but small.** A Dawn capsule is worth ~84M on average (mostly the 1-in-200 Dawnbreaker Spore) and costs nothing when you push Amberbound. But the garden only feeds it so much Dawn: ~19 new Dawn mutations a day in the model, 7 a day measured, so a spore every 10-29 days: 1-2% of a Rainbow Granter. It would take ~288 captures a day (every charge) to reach ~27%. Amber Capture strips the mutation you want and gives pet shards: 0%.
- **Pet-side abilities** (XP, eggs, hunger, max strength, pet mutations) make no coins of their own; they get small flat weights (1-3%) for what they help indirectly.

## Caveats

- This is one late-game garden. Early on, crops are worth far less, so coin finders, growth and sell boosts matter much more, and granters less: weights are a starting point, and every one is yours to change.
- Supply limits (uncoloured crops, crops lacking a mutation, size headroom) are steady-state estimates; a garden with a backlog gets more from the matching granter for a while.
- Abilities interact (Gold Granter uses crops Rainbow could have upgraded); the weights treat each family on its own.
